name: Karan Sharma
title: Software Engineer
blurb:
I design and deliver software for regulated, data-intensive products, with experience across financial services and mortgage technology. My work emphasizes dependable systems, clear user experiences, and strong collaboration with product and operations teams.

This page provides a concise overview of my background, core technical skills, selected experience, and contact details. A full résumé is available for download.

highlights.title: GreenLight
highlights.description: Engineering on consumer-facing financial products, with focus on scalable delivery, compliance-aware implementation, and cross-functional execution from design through production support.

highlights.title: Black Knight
highlights.description: Software development across mortgage and real estate data platforms, including integrations, observability, and long-lived production systems. Following ICE's acquisition of Black Knight, my organization continued as Dark Matter Technologies.
